title: Wallet
creditOnlyNote: Funds are store credit for gacha pulls and packs only — no cash withdrawal.

waiting.title: Waiting for your payment
waiting.body: Open your banking app and pay the QR code. This page updates by itself — if you have already paid, it can take a few seconds to confirm.

credited.title: Payment received
credited.body: Your wallet has been topped up.

canceled.title: Top-up cancelled
canceled.body: Nothing was charged. Start a new top-up whenever you like.

expired.title: The QR code expired
expired.body: Nothing was charged. Start a new top-up to get a fresh QR code.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.body: Nothing was charged. Please try again, or use another payment method.

return.successBody: Your wallet balance has been updated.
return.processingBody: We're confirming your payment — this can take a moment. Your balance will update here automatically.
return.failedBody: Nothing was charged. Please try again, or use another payment method.
return.unknownBody: We couldn't find this payment on your account. Check your transaction history, or contact support if you were charged.
